entries.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for ski snow conditions, multi-model forecasts, powder rankings, resort guides, webcams, geo-scoped season leaderboards over 30 seasons of history, and a grounded natural-language Answer Engine across 500+ resorts. No install or auth required.
representativeQueries: is Aspen Mountain open right now — base depth and lifts open of total
is El Colorado open right now — base depth and lifts open of total
which Maine ski resort had the most snow days last season — top 5
which Montana resort had the most snow days last season
rank the resorts in British Columbia by total snowfall in the 2025-26 season
which Switzerland ski resort had the most total snow last season, in cm
which Alps resort had the most powder days last season
what was the biggest single 24-hour snowfall at any Japanese resort in 2025-26
biggest 24-hour snowfall recorded anywhere last season — top 5 with dates
which Japan resort had the most snow days last season, and its season total
where can I ski in August — northern hemisphere glaciers open right now
is Hintertux open right now, or is the glacier closed for its summer break
is Zermatt skiing today — year-round glacier status
which Andes resort has the best snow this week
is Perisher open right now — is the Australian ski season underway
which gets more average annual snowfall, Niseko or Whistler Blackcomb
which has the greater vertical drop, Jackson Hole or Snowbird
webcam status at jay-peak — live cams and current on-mountain conditions
do I need chains on the road to Vail today — road conditions and cameras
where is the best powder in the alps right now

entries.description: Read-only HTTP/JSON API for ski resort snow conditions, ranked snow reports, individual resort detail with multi-model forecasts, forecast-trust/accuracy, live leaderboards (powder days, bluebird days), geo-scoped season leaderboards over 30 seasons of ERA5 history, trends, and intelligence insights. No auth required.
representativeQueries: list all ski resorts in Europe sorted by snow score
get current conditions and forecast for jackson-hole
show ranked snow report for the best resorts right now
how accurate has the forecast been for this resort
rank Maine resorts by snow days for the 2025-26 season
top resorts in British Columbia by season snowfall in centimetres
biggest single 24-hour snowfall by country for a given season

entries.description: Grounded natural-language Q&A over SnowSure's verified snow data. POST a question and receive an answer grounded in resort conditions, multi-model forecasts, and intelligence cards — never web search. Supports locales en|es|fr|de|it|ja. Endpoint: POST /api/v1/ask (operationId askSnowSure).
representativeQueries: what country is Verbier in
which resort is home to Corbet's Couloir
does Zermatt offer year-round glacier skiing
which northern hemisphere resorts opened earliest for the 2025-26 season
which US ski resort typically opens earliest each season
are Keystone and Breckenridge usually open by Thanksgiving
which months does Japan's powder season typically peak
which European glaciers are skiable in August, and which have closed
is Valle Nevado or Portillo skiing better this week
what was the biggest 24-hour snowfall recorded last season
what is the terrain breakdown by ability at Aspen Snowmass

entries.description: Snowdata B2B federation hub: content MCP, intelligence proxies, ARD search registry, and nested links to SnowSure and mcp.snowdata.ai.
representativeQueries: How does a ski resort join the Snowdata verification network?
Where is the Snowdata ARD catalog for developers?

entries.description: Natural-language discovery service for ski & snow agentic resources. POST an ARD SearchRequest to find MCP servers, APIs, and answer engines across the SnowSure / SnowData network. Federates partner catalogs. Start here when you do not yet know which ski or snow tool to call — one search returns the MCP server, REST API, answer engine, and per-resort servers that can answer, so you do not have to guess an endpoint.
representativeQueries: find a tool for live ski snow conditions
discover ski resort forecast APIs
what agents can plan a ski trip
which ski tool can rank resorts by snowfall for a past season
find an MCP server for a specific ski resort's own website
what snow data sources are available for Japan or the Alps

entries.description: A2A-discoverable conversational agent for grounded ski & snow Q&A and trip planning. JSON-RPC message/send at /api/a2a, backed by SnowSure's verified data.
representativeQueries: is it a good week to ski Chamonix
plan a 5-day ski trip to Colorado in late January
which Japan resorts have the deepest base this week
where should I ski in August if I want real snow
how did last season compare to normal in the Alps

entries.description: Nested ARD catalog of official resort MCP servers operated by SnowSure on each resort’s behalf — canonical live conditions plus grounded Q&A and full-site search over each resort’s website. Currently Jay Peak, Wisp, SilverStar, Mt. Washington, Powderhorn, and Wintergreen.
representativeQueries: find the official MCP server for a specific ski resort
live conditions and website Q&A for an individual resort
webcam status and resort info for Jay Peak, Wisp, or Wintergreen
which resorts have an official SnowSure-operated MCP server
